ranAgainst: the plan base 65061d8 (src unchanged) plus the new and changed cases in test/integration/allowlist-proxy.test.ts and test/unit/footprint.test.ts. Without an isPublicAddress export the proxy test file does not load (a missing named export), so the run used an uncommitted placeholder `export function isPublicAddress(_ip) { return true; }` appended to src/adapters/exec/allowlist-proxy.ts so every case executes; the placeholder was reverted before the commit.
reason: At base the proxy dials whatever an allowlisted name holds and ignores any resolver. A CONNECT to localhost:<echo port> got `HTTP/1.1 200 Connection Established` where 403 was expected, so the production proxy tunnels to the loopback echo server (the same for 127.0.0.1:<echo port>, for 169.254.169.254:80 and 10.0.0.5:443 literals, and through AllowlistEgressProxy with a smuggled resolve property). With a resolve that returns 127.0.0.1 for registry.avarice.test the proxy ignores it and answers 502 (it dials the name), and a resolver that refuses the host is not honored (no 403). isPublicAddress, as a placeholder that always answers true, fails the refused-address list and the non-IP list. In the footprint file, the proxy's network imports do not include node:dns/promises, and resolver seam check (3) fails because the composed proxy hands its whole input object to the call (`startAllowlistProxy(input)` matched: true !== false).
